is_receipt.instructions: Is `img0` a photo or scan of a purchase receipt?

criteria.true: a photo or scan of a purchase receipt
criteria.false: something that is not a purchase receipt

criteria.receipt: Itemized proof of purchase from a store or restaurant
criteria.invoice: Bill requesting payment, naming payer and payee

legibility.instructions: How legible is the text in `img0`?
criteria: Some words readable, totals or names unclear
